event.description:
Join us for Abyssal Heaven Massachusetts regionals and secure your invites for NA Nationals 2026!
The Top 8 players of the event will earn a Mandate of Honor Nationals Invite Card, as well as additional prizing based on attendance.
All players will receive an HVN Regionals binder as well as an exclusive Sapphire promo pack, with additional Sapphire packs handed out to top placing players
Entry Fee: $30
Check in: 10am
Round 1 Start: 11am
The event will be a number of swiss rounds based on attendance.  PLEASE BUY TICKETS HERE: https://www.webwaygames.com/collections/events/products/hvn-massachusetts-regionals-ticket?ticket=hvn-massachusetts-regionals-ticket
